title: Newfoundland expedition (1702)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Newfoundland expedition (1702)", at revision 1370629569, opens: "The Newfoundland expedition was a naval raiding expedition led by English Captain John Leake between August and October 1702 that targeted French colonial settlements on the North Atlantic island of Newfoundland and its satellite, Saint Pierre. The expedition occurred in the early days of Queen Anne's War, as the North American theater of the War of the Spanish Succession is sometimes known." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5977822, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1702 English naval raiding expedition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
